posts.text: PAX Global slashed its HKD-denominated dividend by 75.8%, cutting the annual rate from HK$0.33 to HK$0.08.
CapLand Ascendas REIT increased its SGD-denominated dividend by 36.4%, lifting the annual rate from S$0.11 to S$0.15.
Nike yields 4.37%, 3.1 times its 5-year average of 1.41%, after 23 consecutive years of dividend increases.
Dick's Sporting Goods posted a 31.1% annual dividend growth rate over the last five years.
$TXN goes ex-dividend Oct 30. The company has raised its dividend for 22 straight years, now paying $6.08 annually.
Lowe's has increased its dividend for 28 consecutive years. It currently yields 2.52%, well above its 5-year average of 1.81%.
Intertek reduced its GBP-denominated dividend by 34.5%, lowering the annual rate from £1.65 to £1.08.
Texas Instruments raised its annual dividend from $5.68 to $6.08, a 7.0% increase, extending its streak to 22 years.
